events.title: California’s coastal communities on alert as biggest waves in years hit state
events.description: Hazard warnings issued throughout week after powerful swells and waves of more than 9 metres recorded Multiple coastal hazard warnings were issued this week across California as successive areas of low pressure generated powerful swells and large breaking waves for coastal communities. Beaches and piers were closed last weekend as large waves crashed into California’s coastline. Offshore National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration buoys recorded wave heights of greater than 30ft (9 metres) last Friday. The Monterey, California, buoy recorded a wave height of 34.1ft, which would make it the highest reading in 30 years. Coastal warnings extended from last weekend through this week, with alerts extending until Friday night. Waves of 10-18ft are expected, with local sets of 18-22ft for San Luis Obispo county beaches and Santa Barbara county central coast beaches. These Pacific storm systems are also bringing unsettled conditions across the western US, with heavy rain, mountain snow, and strong winds through the coming days. Already, record-breaking rainfall affected San Fransisco on Wednesday, with heavy rain also causing 32,000 customers to lose power in Sacramento. Into this weekend, a further area of low pressure will bring considerable amounts of moisture for southern Oregon and northern California. By Sunday night, more than 100mm (4in) of rain is expected in places, with further snowfall for areas such as Donner Pass across the northern Sierra Nevada mountains. Continue reading...

events.title: Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia. And, Rep. Gomez resigns amid alleged sexual misconduct
events.description: President Trump took credit for negotiating Jensen Huang's return as CEO of Nvidia. And, Rep. Jimmy Gomez, D-Calif., says his resignation will be effective Dec. 1.

events.title: The human cost of the electric vehicle boom is at the center of a lawsuit in Congo
events.description: A landmark lawsuit in Congo sees 27 residents accuse a Chinese-owned copper and cobalt mine of poisoning their community and the government of failing to protect them.

events.title: Meet Colombia's fuzzy 'water guardians'
events.description: High in the Colombian Andes, a growing number of volunteers are racing to save an unusual plant that helps supply water to millions — one tiny seedling at a time.

events.title: Russian incursions into NATO territory are increasing
events.description: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is seeking to reassure the alliance's eastern European members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 Russian incursions into NATO territory are increasing

events.title: Democrats win House by largest margin in 50 years. And, COP31 ends with no deal
events.description: Democrats have currently flipped 47 House seats and could flip 49 total. And, climate change talks at COP31 ran two days longer than expected, becoming the longest conference in the summit's history.

events.title: Ukraine: Zelenskyy and Hungary's Magyar meet amid thaw in ties
events.description: Hungary's Prime Minister Peter Magyar has arrived in Ukraine for meetings with President Volodymyr Zelenskyy and ethnic Hungarians. Both leaders say they want better relations after a change of leadership in Budapest.

events.title: Why Iran's medicine supply chain is failing
events.description: Pharmacies in Iran are closing, hospital deliveries have stalled and patients are rationing doses or turning to black markets.

events.title: Germany's Wadephul 'shocked' by Trump's Nvidia intervention
events.description: The German foreign minister has criticized Donald Trump's interference in the chip-maker's economic activities. Jensen Huang was brought back after stepping down as Nvidia CEO amid multiple scandals.

events.title: How cautious investors are struggling to avoid the AI bubble
events.description: From Nvidia to Coreweave, AI and tech stocks have swung sharply in recent months. Some investors still see plenty of room to run, while others are trying to diversify — and finding it harder than expected.

events.title: Istanbul 'lion hunt' ends with no big cat found after all
events.description: After a major search operation for a lion on the loose in Istanbul woodlands, Turkish authorities said "the animal was neither a lion nor any other big cat."

events.title: Pakistani astronaut to join Chinese space mission
events.description: A Pakistani astronaut is set to become to the first foreigner to board China's Tiangong space station. Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, a payload specialist, will join the Shenzhou-24 mission when it launches on Wednesday.

events.title: Jensen Huang's Nvidia comeback sends AI videos into overdrive
events.description: Just 11 days after resigning as Nvidia CEO, Jensen Huang’s return has unleashed a fresh wave of AI-generated videos. But the internet has changed its tune: while last week’s memes mocked Huang, many now celebrate his comeback. One viral video purportedly showing him dancing is actually AI-manipulated footage of a basketball coach from 2016. From humiliation to hero worship, the technology Nvidia helped popularise is rewriting the narrative surrounding its own CEO, as Vedika Bahl explains.

events.title: France's ex-president Nicolas Sarkozy, wife Carla Bruni to stand trial for alleged witness tampering
events.description: France's former president Nicolas Sarkozy and his wife, singer Carla Bruni-Sarkozy, are set to be tried in 2027 on charges of "criminal conspiracy with intent to commit fraud" as well as benefitting from witness tampering. The new charges are related to the Sarkozy couple's actions during the case examining illegal campaign funding from Libyan strongman Muammar Gaddafi over which Sarkozy was imprisoned last year.
events.ticker_label: 💥 France's ex-president Nicolas Sarkozy, wife Carla Bruni to stand trial for alleged witness tampering

events.title: 'We are ready to facilitate removal of Netanyahu': Head of Israel's Arab-majority Joint List
events.description: In an interview with FRANCE 24, the head of the Arab-majority Joint List said his political alliance is prepared to play a decisive role in bringing down Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government following the recent election. "We are ready to facilitate the removal of Netanyahu" from power, Yousef Jabareen said, signalling a willingness to explore political alliances beyond traditional divisions in Israeli politics.

events.title: 'Tis the season to be green: Can the Christmas holidays be a present for the planet?
events.description: With the holiday season just around the corner, we take a look at its environmental impact. We discuss how to make Christmas a little greener as consumers, whether plastic trees or natural ones are better for the planet, and what small steps we can all take to reduce our carbon footprint during the festivities.

events.title: Armed men take at least 25 hostages in supermarket in Colombia tourist hotspot
events.description: A group of armed men are holding at least 25 people hostage in a supermarket in Colombia, according to officials.

events.title: Gisele Pelicot 'deeply shocked' as nude photos of her sent to media
events.description: Gisele Pelicot has said she is "deeply shocked" and "humiliated" after nude images of her were sent to the media without her consent to promote a new book about coercive control.

events.title: Gisèle Pelicot condemns publisher for using nude images from her rape case in book promo
events.description: Gisèle Pelicot says she is shocked that a Paris publisher used nude images taken by her rapist ex-husband to promote a book about her case

events.title: Houthi rebels close in on Aden as Yemeni forces dig in behind a fortified line
events.description: Iran-backed Houthi rebels have advanced close to Yemen's government seat in Aden
events.ticker_label: 💥 Houthi rebels close in on Aden as Yemeni forces dig in behind a fortified line

events.title: Officials backtrack after 24-hour hunt for Istanbul lioness, saying she never existed
events.description: Turkish officials say a lioness that was subject to a 24-hour search and sparked panic among Istanbul residents does not actually exist

events.title: Bangladesh's ousted leader Hasina plans to return home from exile on Dec 16
events.description: Ousted Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina plans to return home from exile in India on Dec. 16

events.title: Colombia: Guterres urges renewed commitment to landmark peace deal
events.description: UN Secretary-General António Guterres has commended Colombia for progress achieved in the decade since a landmark accord known as the Final Peace Agreement ended more than 50 years of insurgency but stressed the need to fully implement its provisions.

events.title: Guterres laments COP31 outcome, urges climate justice from Barbados
events.description: Secretary-General António Guterres on Sunday expressed deep disappointment over the collapse of COP31 climate negotiations, using a visit to Barbados to call for stronger action on fossil fuels, climate finance and support for vulnerable nations.

events.title: ‘I had a better life in Iran’: Afghan women forced home struggle to rebuild
events.description: For five years, Zahra cared for an elderly woman in Iran and earned enough to get by. Now back in Herat, western Afghanistan, the 28-year-old trained midwife is unemployed. She lives with her parents and siblings, apart from her six-year-old son, who lives with her ex-husband.

events.title: Microsoft declares 'Code Red' after historic service outage
events.description: Microsoft declared a "Code Red" after a historic 24-hour outage hit most of its 420 to 450 million users that wa blamed on a Windows scalability defect.

events.title: Former Florida mayor urges American Jews to fight back against rising antisemitism
events.description: In "The Jewish Fight for America," Gabe Groisman says forces on the left and right are trying to distance American Jews from Israel and unlearn Zionism.

events.title: Iran flogs female singer 74 times for performing without hijab in viral YouTube concert
events.description: Lawyers said singer Parastoo Ahmadi and members of her concert team received 74 lashes each in Qom after performing without a hijab. They also face two-year bans.

events.title: Captain who abandoned passengers on sinking Costa Concordia cruise ship released early from prison
events.description: Costa Concordia captain Francesco Schettino is out of a Rome prison after 9 years, set to serve the remaining 7 years on supervised probation, lawyer says.

events.title: Trump says Iran unleashed missile, drone surge after midterms
events.description: President Donald Trump says Iran launched more missiles and drones over the past week than at any point in over a year, and all were knocked down with no damage.
events.ticker_label: 🪖 Trump says Iran unleashed missile, drone surge after midterms

events.title: Flavio Bolsonaro claims judge ordered passports seized just 7 minutes after Brazil election loss
events.description: Former presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro alleges election interference by Brazil’s Supreme Court and discusses political persecution and the future of his family’s political movement.
